meta.notes: Logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, pricing, retention and platform-engineering benchmarks. Lead-time distributions are right-skewed: sample lognormal with the given median and CV. meta.percentile_semantics: p10..p90 are cross-sectional percentiles of companies (or shipments/plants where noted), not time-series percentiles. 'distribution' is the recommended family for sampling between the anchors; 'empirical' means piecewise-linear quantile interpolation across p10..p90 with tails clamped.
